deploy-bot: terraform apply started — repo: infra/gpupool — env: dc1 — plan id: plan-20260320-3 — user: jasmin — commit: 7ad3f1c (tag: v1.7.0-rc3) — command: `terraform apply -auto-approve`
jasmin: kicking off a small canary for dc1, watching ASG health and SG changes :eyes:
ori: I skimmed the plan — it shows replacement for `aws_autoscaling_group.main` and a modification to security group `gpupool-access` (removing 0.0.0.0/0). is that expected?
lee: yes expected. we're tightening ingress to prod-ipset. this should be fine but ASG replacement will spin hosts.
sre-oncall: FYI if ASG replacement happens we may see short capacity dips. i'll keep an eye on instance churn and LB healthy host counts.
dinesh: plan output also shows `create_before_destroy = false` on the launch template usage — that means replacement will be destructive. flagging a potential live-traffic impact.
jasmin: good catch. pausing the apply. @deploy-bot cancel apply — reason: ASG replacement risk and need to pin launch template. :warning:
deploy-bot: apply cancelled by jasmin — plan plan-20260320-3 retained, URL: https://ci.redwood/plan/plan-20260320-3 — cancelled at 1795002275
ori: proposal: update module to set `create_before_destroy = true` or pin LT version `lt-2026-03-19-9` so we don't replace live instances. I'll open a tiny PR now.
lee: thumbs up. don't merge until we confirm canary window. adding note to release docs about SG tightening and LT pinning. :memo:
dinesh: action item for next run: ensure a +20% capacity buffer for the canary host group to avoid throttling. also add a brief rollback script that reverts LT to previous version.
jasmin: re-scheduling canary for 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC after LT pin PR merges. will trigger run with pinned LT and `create_before_destroy = true`.
deploy-bot: scheduled terraform apply for plan-20260320-3 at 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z by jasmin — will notify on start/finish.
lee: :thumbsup: thanks team, good catch.
sre-oncall: I'll standby during window and prepare quick rollback steps.
